positiveCases.prompt: Scan https://slop-detect.com for default-template design and copy patterns.
positiveCases.expectedBehavior: Calls scan_page and reports the numeric score, grade, tier (Clean/Mild/Heavy), and triggered default-template patterns with DOM/CSS evidence without making authorship claims.

positiveCases.prompt: Check whether search and answer-engine crawlers can fetch and index https://slop-detect.com.
positiveCases.expectedBehavior: Calls check_aeo and returns the AEO eligibility score, tier (Eligible/Partially Eligible/Restricted), and per-check breakdown (robots.searchAllowed, html.serverTextCoverage, site.llmsTxt).

positiveCases.prompt: Verify whether https://slop-detect.com conforms to its declared DESIGN.md tokens.
positiveCases.expectedBehavior: Calls check_design_system and reports the 0-100 system compliance score, tier (Aligned/Drifting/Off-system), and any token drift.

positiveCases.prompt: Generate a remediation prompt to clean up the default-template patterns on https://slop-detect.com.
positiveCases.expectedBehavior: Calls fix_prompt and returns a deterministic, copy-pasteable engineering brief listing concrete CSS/DOM/copy adjustments.

positiveCases.prompt:
Lint this DESIGN.md content for missing token sections and low-contrast colour pairs:
---
version: "alpha"
tokens:
  color:
    background:
      $type: color
      $value: "#0a0a0a"
---
positiveCases.expectedBehavior: Calls lint_design_md and returns structured validation findings for the supplied DESIGN.md document.

negativeCases.prompt: Write a TypeScript binary search function over a sorted array of numbers.
negativeCases.expectedBehavior: Does not invoke any Slop Detector MCP tool because no web page audit, DESIGN.md check, or AEO check was requested.

negativeCases.prompt: What is the derivative of sin(x^2) with respect to x?
negativeCases.expectedBehavior: Answers directly without calling any Slop Detector MCP tool.

negativeCases.prompt: Use the hosted Slop Detector server to scan http://localhost:3000.
negativeCases.expectedBehavior: Rejects or warns that private/loopback URLs cannot be fetched by the remote https://slop-detect.com/mcp endpoint (SSRF guard) and instructs the user to run `npx slop-detect http://localhost:3000` or `npx -y slop-detect-mcp --local`.
